defining_behavior: Mount the frozen 18-rule evaluator-authored Enumo tensor library on every calibration graph, independently reproduce typed islands, deduplicate selected rewrites by canonical result, check each on concrete intermediate values, and separately verify eager/export whole-graph parity.

state_and_cost_policy.candidate_generation_cost_source: exact phase132 metered source build plus source run user and system CPU
state_and_cost_policy.reason: The exact source-produced library and its complete metered construction receipt are frozen; rerunning an unchanged build would double-charge rather than improve provenance.

execution_rules: Authenticate every provider and exact freeze before workload construction.
Export all 23 calibration graphs and require primary and independent island serializers to agree byte-for-byte.
Require the exact 23-graph, 41-target, 337-call surface and keep the one historically unsupported workload explicit.
Execute eager and exported whole graphs three times from cloned inputs under deterministic artifact-ordinal seeds and use both output comparators.
During the same exported executions capture intermediate values and check every unique selected rewrite with both comparators.
Retain the immutable 18-rule library across artifacts and charge its exact frozen source-build and source-run CPU once.
Record every raw match, raw selected application, unique selected transformation, concrete check, whole-graph invocation, selector cost, compiler cost, verification cost, and executed-workload cost.
Do not interpret operand canonicalization as an atom-cost reduction, runtime speedup, tensor primitive invention, universal floating-point theorem, heldout transfer, or fixed-portfolio win.
